name: Beast Boy
summary: The class clown who can turn into a T. rex. Garfield Logan, the green-skinned shapeshifter of the Doom Patrol and Teen Titans, becomes any animal he can picture.
origin: Beast Boy is the class clown of the DC universe, and you should never underestimate the class clown. Arnold Drake and Bob Brown introduced Garfield Logan in Doom Patrol #99 in 1965. As a kid in Africa he caught a rare disease, and the experimental treatment his scientist father used to save him turned his skin green and let him become any animal he could picture, always in the same shade of green. He started out with the Doom Patrol, later spent years in the Teen Titans and went by Changeling for a long stretch. Behind the jokes is a kid who has lost a lot of family, which is why the Titans feel like home to him.

storyline.title: Doom Patrol kid
storyline.beat: Garfield Logan appears in Doom Patrol #99. An experimental treatment for a rare disease turned him green and let him become any animal.

storyline.title: Teen Titan
storyline.beat: He joins The New Teen Titans under the name Changeling and becomes the team's joker.

storyline.title: Heartbreak
storyline.beat: Gar falls for teammate Terra, who turns out to be a spy for Deathstroke. Her betrayal stays with him for years.

storyline.title: Beast Boy again
storyline.beat: Geoff Johns's Teen Titans brings back the Beast Boy name, the same year the hit cartoon makes him a fan favourite.

gossip.text: Beast Boy started out as a Teen Titan.
gossip.truth: He debuted in Doom Patrol in 1965 and joined the Titans in 1980.

gossip.text: He is green because of the treatment that saved him from a rare illness as a child.
He went by Changeling through most of the 1980s and 1990s.
The Teen Titans cartoon (2003) and Teen Titans Go! made him one of DC's best-known young heroes.
His animal forms come out green, matching his skin.

quiz.q: Which team did Beast Boy debut with?
What name did Gar use in the 1980s Teen Titans?
Which teammate betrayed the Titans in The Judas Contract?

theme.tagline: Becomes any animal, still eats like a teenager.

timeline.title: The green kid
timeline.note: Doom Patrol #99 introduces Garfield Logan, a green-skinned teen who can turn into any animal.

timeline.title: Losing his family
timeline.note: The Doom Patrol sacrifice themselves to save a small town in issue #121, leaving Gar without his found family.

timeline.title: Changeling joins up
timeline.note: Now calling himself Changeling, Gar becomes the class clown of the New Teen Titans.

timeline.title: The Judas Contract
timeline.note: Gar's crush Terra is unmasked as Deathstroke's mole inside the Titans, and his heart is shattered.

timeline.title: Teen Titans on TV
timeline.note: Back as Beast Boy, Gar becomes the goofy, big-hearted core of the Teen Titans cartoon.

timeline.title: Teen Titans Go!
timeline.note: The slapstick spinoff turns Beast Boy into a kids' TV fixture for more than a decade.

timeline.title: Titans
timeline.note: Ryan Potter plays Gar in the live-action Titans series, tiger form and all.
